notes.title: Three Years of Strange Horticulture!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, everyone![/h3]

As we celebrate [b]the third anniversary of Strange Horticulture[/b], we want to take a moment to reflect on this incredible journey and [b]share our heartfelt gratitude[/b]. When we first started developing a game about a little plant shop nestled in the mysterious town of Undermere, [b]we couldn’t have imagined how deeply it would connect with all of you[/b]. 

Your [b]support[/b], [b]curiosity[/b], and [b]passion [/b]have made these three years unforgettable.

It’s been truly humbling to see Strange Horticulture grow, finding its way to new platforms and players around the world. [b]From PC to the Nintendo Switch, to Xbox and PlayStation, to eventually even making its way to mobile[/b], the game has reached a wider audience than we ever dreamed of. Along the way, it’s been [b]recognized with kind words from critics and players alike[/b], and the stories you’ve shared with us mean so much. Whether it was playing along with a parent, child, or partner, diving into the world of Undermere to help you through a tough time, or playing through multiple times to unlock every ending, [b]your adventures have made this world come alive.[/b]

We’re also thrilled to be working on the next chapter of this journey: [b][i]Strange Antiquities[/i][/b]. Many of you already know about this standalone sequel, and we’re so excited to dive deeper into what you can expect.

[h5]For the ones that don’t know yet:[/h5]

Set several years after the events of Strange Horticulture, Strange Antiquities takes you back to Undermere, but this time, [b]you’ll run a shop stocked with occult antiques[/b]. As the apprentice of a Thaumaturge, your role will be to[b] identify and explore mysterious artifacts, each holding secrets and stories of their own[/b]. The game keeps the immersive puzzle-solving spirit of Strange Horticulture while introducing new ideas, new characters, and an intriguing new mystery unfolding outside the cosy confines of your shop.

As we continue working on Strange Antiquities, we’re reminded every day that [b]none of this would be possible without your support[/b]. Your passion for Strange Horticulture inspires us to create experiences that are just as immersive, mysterious, and meaningful. We can’t wait to share more details with you in the coming months, and [b]we hope you’ll join us for this next chapter.[/b]

Thank you for being part of this journey. Here’s to three wonderful years of Strange Horticulture and the exciting adventures ahead with Strange Antiquities!

John & Rob

notes.title: Strange Horticulture review: quiet, meticulous, delightful, dark and beguiling
notes.notes:
Ah, to be good with plants. Apparently it was a thing, wasn't it, that my generation all got into house plants, especially during lockdown. A friend of mine has a positively ebullient front room full of lush, green darlings that have names like Hercules. My brother-in-law, absent any real space, has mounted glass spheres of water on his wall and grows little flowers and trailing vines from them. I, on the other hand, am a plant killer. Apart from in Strange Horticulture, when I run a spooky and ethereal plant shop in a town called Undermere, in an alternate-universe version of The Lake District. There, my plants are happy and weird, and with them I can save the world.

Dear Horticulturists,

We're happy to see that many of you have been enjoying our demo so far. We've been tinkering away at the game, and have some exciting new things to share.

First, a proper introduction to Undermere and the story of Strange Horticulture through an all-new trailer! What does the Horticulturist do exactly, and what is happening in and around Undermere?

[previewyoutube=v69Jp10nLK8;full][/previewyoutube]

Proper spooky. We hope you enjoyed that as much as we do!

[h2]Steam Next Fest - Demo Update[/h2]
And that's not all. We've updated our demo with some features and tweaks that were suggested by those of you who gave the previous demo a try.

[b]Changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] More clues to find the correct plants early on, making it easier to identify them.
[*] Added an intro page to the encyclopedia to explain what it is and how it should be used.
[*] Reworked the 'game over' state. The day no longer fully resets upon getting 3 plants wrong. Instead, you will be given a simple puzzle to solve, after which you'll be back to your last checkpoint.
[*] Added more hints. For example, if you haven't explored yet by the time you need a certain plant, a hint will pop up.
[*] You can now drag labels to the plants as well as the other way around.
[*] You can now enable auto-labeling in the settings. This will label any plant you've identified.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing Strange Horticulture - Gamescom 2021
notes.notes:
Welcome, Horticulturists.

We are Bad Viking, the team behind [i]Strange Horticulture[/i], an adventure puzzle game that thrusts you into an occult mystery. We are very excited to reveal our game at Gamescom 2021 together with Iceberg Interactive!

Armed with little more than the will to explore and a collection of rare plants, can you unravel the dark secrets of Undermere?

[previewyoutube=g_gqkVl21Bk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Play the demo![/h2]
Below we will go into further detail about what Strange Horticulture is all about, but why read that when you can experience it yourself? We've prepared a lovely little demo that lets you experience the first two days of Strange Horticulture!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574580/Strange_Horticulture/

[h2]Welcome To Undermere[/h2]
A quaint, unassuming town surrounded by hag-filled forests and rugged mountains, Undermere is where your shop is located. The denizens of Undermere look to you to provide them with assistance in matters that often border on the occult. Some hear whispers emanating from empty rooms, others have trouble sleeping as their nightmares grow more vivid. Only your plants can help them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/58d944a7b36440f89c887a6d1086dab4567912a6.gif[/img]

Identify the correct plant by using your trusty encyclopedia to help your customers and learn more about the strange happenings in Undermere.


[h2]The Lands Beyond[/h2]
Explore the lands beyond your store to find new plants, but be careful! The dark woods and lakes are not always friendly to a simple herbalist. You might discover powers beyond your wildest dreams - or lose your mind completely. Use context clues to determine which places to visit, and which to avoid!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/43f3298bb4eb5c0d1e03b8c251b04b556cd1de99.gif[/img]


[h2]Pet Your Cat[/h2]
You have a cat. You should pet it often.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/15d0cbf88652ab4906e3f2d8542df80d308cc65c.gif[/img]

That is all from us for now. Make sure you try out the demo, and let us know what you think!
